learnings: Tool errors (API failures, parsing errors) should be clearly distinguished from security-based inconclusive verdicts to avoid triggering unnecessary escalation audits

When a model encounters an API error on a non-executable metadata file like .SRCINFO, the audit system should either retry or mark the file as 'skipped due to error' rather than making the entire package verdict inconclusive

Advisory reports with tool errors should not contribute to disagreement calculations - the system correctly identified openrouter/free as advisory-only, but qwen3-235b's API error still triggered an escalation
